# RadioGroup

A labeled group of mutually exclusive options built on react-aria-components `RadioGroup`. Roving tabindex, arrow-key navigation, and group labelling come from React Aria; visual states are driven purely by RAC data attributes (`data-disabled`, `data-invalid`, `data-orientation`) and `--ds-*` tokens. Selection is single-value: `value`/`defaultValue` plus `onChange` receive the selected `Radio`'s `value` string.

Import: `import { RadioGroup } from '@ds/react';` — the only public entry point.

Built on react-aria-components `RadioGroup`; keyboard behavior, ARIA, and focus management ship inside. All `RadioGroup` base props (e.g. event handlers, `isDisabled`, `autoFocus`) are also legal here, with the props listed below overriding or narrowing them.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | yes | — | The `Radio` options of the group. |
| `className` | `string` | no | — | Additional CSS class appended after the component's own classes. Narrowed from the react-aria-components render-prop form to a plain string; inline `style` is intentionally not supported (token rule). |
| `description` | `string` | no | — | Optional helper text rendered below the label and associated with the group via `aria-describedby`. |
| `errorMessage` | `string` | no | — | Error text rendered below the options. Only shown while the group is invalid (`isInvalid` or form validation); it is associated with the group via `aria-describedby`. |
| `label` | `string` | yes | — | Visible label naming the group. Required: a radio group without an accessible name is an accessibility failure, so the label is part of the typed contract rather than an optional slot. |
| `orientation` | `"horizontal" \| "vertical"` | no | `'vertical'` | Layout axis of the options. `vertical` stacks the radios, `horizontal` lays them out in a wrapping row. Keyboard arrow navigation follows the orientation automatically via React Aria. |

Inherited-but-legal `RadioGroup` props (from the registry `racProps` enumeration): `defaultValue: string \| null`, `isDisabled: boolean`, `isInvalid: boolean`, `isReadOnly: boolean`, `isRequired: boolean`, `name: string`, `onChange: (value: string) => void`, `value: string \| null`. Commonly needed props inherited from the react-aria-components base; the full react-aria-components RadioGroupProps surface is also legal.

Theming hooks: `--ds-radio-*` component-tier tokens (see registries/tokens-index.json); they belong to this component ONLY (NR-008).

## Accessibility

- Keyboard behavior, ARIA semantics, and focus management come from react-aria-components `RadioGroup` — never re-implement or bypass them.
- Interaction states are exposed as data attributes (`[data-hovered]`, `[data-focus-visible]`, `[data-disabled]`, …); the focus-visible ring uses `var(--ds-color-border-focus)` and `var(--ds-shadow-focus-ring)`.
- Color pairs used by this system are contrast-audited (WCAG 2.2 AA (normal text)); see registries/contrast-report.json. Only audited foreground/background token pairs are legal.

## Examples

```tsx
<RadioGroup label="Notification method" onChange={setMethod}>
  <Radio value="email">Email</Radio>
  <Radio value="sms">SMS</Radio>
</RadioGroup>
<RadioGroup label="Density" orientation="horizontal" defaultValue="cozy">
  <Radio value="compact">Compact</Radio>
  <Radio value="cozy">Cozy</Radio>
</RadioGroup>
<RadioGroup label="Plan" isInvalid errorMessage="Choose a plan to continue.">
  <Radio value="free">Free</Radio>
  <Radio value="pro">Pro</Radio>
</RadioGroup>
```
